name: Aasimar
printedArtCredit: David Hudnut, An aasimar paladin, p. 6.
sourceDistinctions: The p. 7 player traits give Daylight once daily at caster level equal to character level. Level adjustment increases ECL, not character level.
Native Outsider is the base type. The profile adds Extraplanar when away from the Material Plane, subject to the core transitive-plane exception.
Acid, cold, and electricity resistance are each 5. The published fifth-edition Aasimar profiles retain their own rules.
No Aasimar correction appears in the November 2004 Planar Handbook errata. The separate Monster Manual warrior is not part of this profile.
portraitForm: Iona Vale, an original Aasimar Paladin
